verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party organization plugin manages members, teams, roles and permissions, and the homepage claims "Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control." Supporting evidence includes organization-owned API keys and Auth0 organization/member migration. A community developer independently reports getting organizations and multi-tenancy from the included plugins without special code. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the invitation flow (send, accept, expire), with invitations evidenced only by a homepage tagline; deeper docs on the membership data model and tenant isolation.
